create_S3Logger: create an S3Logger instance with S3 bucket, region, and AWS credentials for batch logging
create_S3Logger_with_prefix: create an S3Logger with team and key prefixes to organize logged data in nested S3 paths
create_S3Logger_strip_base64: create an S3Logger that strips base64 files from messages before logging to S3
log_success_event_to_s3: log a successful LLM event to S3 with batched async upload using SigV4 authentication
log_failure_event_to_s3: log a failed LLM event to S3 with batched async upload and retry on transient errors
log_audit_log_to_s3: batch and upload audit logs to S3 under the audit_logs prefix with daily file organization
retrieve_from_s3_cold_storage: retrieve a stored proxy server request from S3 cold storage using its object key
